parsed.name: IT8500系列直流电子负载
parsed.description: IT8500系列是一类可编程直流电子负载，用于对电源、电池、适配器和直流变换器施加受控负载并测量电压、电流等参数。该设备支持恒流与恒压等工作方式，可用于电源性能测试、老化测试和实验室台式直流源评估。
parsed.description_en: The IT8500 Series is a programmable DC electronic load used to apply controlled loading to power supplies, batteries, adapters, and DC converters while measuring voltage and current. It supports operating modes such as constant current and constant voltage for power characterization, burn-in, and general laboratory evaluation of DC sources.
